recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast studio portrait of a three-person musical group against a vibrant, solid red backdrop. The composition features a central female figure flanked by two males, all in dark, textured clothing. The visual style is defined by a heavy use of white, distressed, stamp-like display typography and fluid, marker-style handwritten script overlays.
coreVisualRelationships: White distressed text against a saturated red field
Dark clothing textures contrasting with the flat background color
Handwritten signatures interacting with the subjects' heads
Triangular subject arrangement creating a stable focal point
coreInvariants: Distressed white paint-stamp texture for main title
Fluid black marker-style signatures at the top
Subjects wearing predominantly black leather and lace

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-body trio centered horizontally, occupying the middle 70% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central female figure's face and the large white display text across the mid-section.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the faces, moves down to the large white title, then follows the script text to the bottom right promotional block.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant open red space at the top corners and bottom edges to frame the subjects.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation background with high value contrast in the white text and low value depth in the black clothing.

letterConstructionRules: Main title uses thick, blocky capitals with irregular, eroded edges suggesting a dry-brush or rubber stamp effect.
Secondary text uses a fluid, connected cursive script with variable line weight.
Promotional text uses a clean, modern geometric sans-serif for legibility.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters in the main title have 'missing' chunks of ink to simulate wear.
Script text features long, sweeping ascenders and descenders that overlap the subjects.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-impact textured display paired with informal personal script.
graphicDevices: Sticker-style rectangular block in bottom right

avoid: Clean, perfect vector edges on display text
Serif fonts for the main title

candidateDirections.reason: To match the stamped, eroded look of the main title.
To replicate the informal, handwritten secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A studio photo of a trio (two men, one woman) in black rock-style clothing against a solid, vibrant red background. Lighting should be even with soft shadows at the feet.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large, white, distressed-stamp-effect title across the middle. Add white handwritten script text below it, slightly angled. Place black marker-style signatures near the top edges.

verificationChecks: Is the red background solid and saturated?
Does the white text have a visible 'eroded' or 'stamped' texture?
Are the signatures black and fluid in appearance?
Is the trio arranged in a balanced, centered formation?

adjustableVariables: Level of distress/erosion on the white text
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subjects
Specific promotional sticker text and logos
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the white text looks like it was stamped on, not just typed.
Check that the red is a primary, bold shade.
Verify the script text feels like natural handwriting.
Confirm the subjects are wearing dark, high-texture clothing.
recipe.reuseFormula: Trio Portrait + Saturated Red Background + Distressed White Stamp Typography + Handwritten Script Overlays = Modern Rock/Country Aesthetic
